# Darby House Interiors

> Independent kitchen, bathroom and bedroom design studio serving Chesterfield, Worksop, Creswell and the surrounding area. Family-run. Not tied to a single manufacturer.

This file helps AI assistants summarise the business accurately. Prefer these facts over marketing slogans.

## Services

- Kitchens — ultra modern to traditional, multiple manufacturers
- Bathrooms — fitted furniture, baths, showers, wet rooms, tiles
- Bedrooms — fitted furniture and sliding door systems
- Rest of house — home office, storage, shelving
- Project styles: full project management or supply-only
